description: The plot titled "ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters with different r with Gazeta dataset" illustrates the performance of different model configurations in terms of the ROUGE-1 metric. The x-axis, labeled "logr," is a logarithmic scale ranging from 0 to 9. The y-axis, labeled "ROUGE-1," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 35. The plot includes four lines representing different configurations: TS + LoRA (red), MBart + LoRA (green), TS + AdaLoRA (purple), and MBart + AdaLoRA (orange). The TS + LoRA line starts at approximately 5 on the y-axis and ends around 25, showing a steady increase. The MBart + LoRA line starts at around 10 and ends near 30, also showing a steady increase. The TS + AdaLoRA line starts at about 15 and ends near 30, with a slight dip around the middle. The MBart + AdaLoRA line starts at around 20 and ends near 35, with a sharp increase around the middle.
